note: Masking word lists for one dataset (docs/plan-pii-mask.md, Masker). Written from dev-set OCR only. ADDRESS was added because a dev receipt prints a customer address after 'ADDRESS :'; BILL TO is not a label word because 'BILL TOTAL' would match it (letters may follow a label) and refuse the receipt. modes: r0 = label and pattern rules; rev1 = allowlist (keep date, amount and total-keyword detections, hide the rest), the revision after r0 missed most names.
